name: Japan Engine Corporation
summary: Japan Engine Corporation, headquartered in Akashi, Japan, and formed in 1910, is an engineering firm that designs, develops, produces, maintains, sells and licenses engines and related components. It is particularly known for UE engines used on ships such as container ships, tankers, bulk carriers and car carriers, and also makes bedplates, resin granulators and valve blocks. It was Kobe Diesel Co., Ltd. until April 2017.
